items.title: 66086_Zilner T. Randolph oral history interview
items.q: MR. DE MICHAEL: Interview with Zilner T. Randolph, Part One, conducted by Don DeMichael

ctx.x: MR. DE MICHAEL: Interview with Zilner T. Randolph, Part One, conducted by Don DeMichael at Mr. Randolph's home, Sangamon 6557 South Sanglin Street, Chicago, February 13th, 1977.
-- Of course, now, you have -- you know the date because they have it. I was born on January 28th, 1899, in Durham, Arkansas. I think you have that.
